note: item 10: how the dry-run bots answer scenarios (hoard-sim --scenario-bot NAME). Per bot the act types it prefers, first wins among the open options (never sleep or exit); with none preferred it ignores, else takes the first open option. random draws among the open options. The six bots of scenario-spec.md section 8.5 run these policies: burner raze_all, sleeper-hoarder rest_only, protector protect_one, priest priest, schemer schemer, random random (data/policies/random.json).
